title: The Moon Checks Out of Capricorn
skyStory: The moon is packing up its guest room in Capricorn, a one percent sliver peeking out like a nightlight. It leaves a thank-you note for Saturn, written in very small, very neat handwriting. Mars, bored all week, cracks his knuckles. The weekend is coming, the sky is waking up, and something wants to be started tonight.

reading: The woodpile at the cabin is looking good, metaphorically, and today you get to light the first real fire of the year's projects. Pick the thing you have been circling since New Year's Day and do the very first step. Not the plan. The step. The [[Ace of Wands]] is literally on fire with approval.

Around 5:45 pm, someone will thank you for something you did so long ago you forgot it. The [[Six of Pentacles]] wants you to say just thank you back, with no mumbled 'oh, it was nothing.' It was something. You are allowed to have done something good.
joel.mission: Take the very first physical step on one project, even if it is just opening the folder.
joel.omen: Smoke rising straight up from a chimney. It means your intentions are travelling straight to the right place.

reading: Your moon is leaving your sign today with a wink, and it is leaving you a parting gift: one clever shortcut. Somewhere in your routine is a step you do out of habit that does not need doing. The Wood Rat will spot it before lunch. Skip it with glee.

Tonight, tell a story. Not a work story, an old one, from when you were small and the snow was taller than you. Your hands will start dancing about thirty seconds in. Let them. The [[Page of Cups]] is listening with its chin in its hands.
nancy.mission: Find one step in your routine you can skip forever, and skip it with a little flourish.
nancy.omen: A snowbank taller than a car. It means an old memory is about to make you laugh out loud.

together.text: Plan one tiny adventure for the weekend, separately, then compare notes by text. A walk somewhere new. A different breakfast spot. A snow angel in an unexpected location. Whoever has the sillier plan wins, and the prize is bragging rights until Monday.
